workload: fresh-process CLI: read SVG, decode 64 rects, raster 256x256 RGBA tile, write raw RGBA
rss_method: maximum of nine /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size observations (two warmup and seven measured fresh child processes)
timing_method: Python time.perf_counter around seven measured fresh /usr/bin/time -l CLI processes after two warmups; includes startup, input read, decode, raster and output write; filesystem caches were not evicted
note: End-to-end CLI workload, not an isolated raster-kernel benchmark.
